newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma vols steady despite lively spot.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma vols steady despite lively spot.

text.p: Ecu/drachma option volatilities were fluctuating in familiar ranges shielded from a more volatile spot by large vol spreads, option dealers said.
"Vol spreads are relatively large giving implied ecu/drachma volatilities some breathing room to absorb a more volatile spot," said an option trader at private Alpha Credit Bank.
Ecu/drachma bids were ranging between 303.2 and 305.2 with standard deviation at 0.79 for the week February 27 to March 5.
Demand for ecu/drachma puts still outweighed demand for calls with interest for mark/drachma options lagging far behind, the trader said.

"Ecu puts are still the darling of the local market with mark/drachma options falling far behind," he said. "I would describe trading activity as normal this week with interbank dealings in options to be more of a short-term nature."
One-month ecu/drachma options were flat at 3.0/5.0 percent, six-month at 6.0/8.0 and 12-month at 7.7-9.7, the trader said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
